description: Defines the ContentDisplayOptions class which manages display and editor options for content parts and fields in OrchardCore CMS, including methods to add, remove, and configure display modes and editors.

classes.name: ContentDisplayOptions
classes.description: Manages display and editing options for content parts and fields, including configuration of display modes and drivers.

methods.name: ForContentPartDisplayMode
methods.description: Configures display mode for a specific content part type using a display driver and predicate.

methods.name: ForContentPartEditor
methods.description: Configures editor for a specific content part type using an editor driver and predicate.

methods.name: RemoveContentPartDisplayDriver
methods.description: Removes a display driver from a content part type.

methods.name: GetOrAddContentPartDisplayOption
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ContentPartDisplayOption for a given content part type.

methods.name: ForContentFieldDisplayMode
methods.description: Configures display mode for a specific content field type using a display driver and predicate.

methods.name: ForContentFieldEditor
methods.description: Configures editor for a specific content field type using an editor driver and predicate.

methods.name: RemoveContentFieldDisplayDriver
methods.description: Removes a display driver from a content field type.

methods.name: GetOrAddContentFieldDisplayOption
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ContentFieldDisplayOption for a given content field type.
